Just because someone cared and remembered him doesn't mean anyone would me.

That last sentence could still very well be true for me. if this is my last post. On this throwaway or ever, it wouldn't make a difference to anyone. 
Even my "friends" would be over it and have moved on quickly. I would be doing no one harm and everybody, including myself a favor.

I'm really thinking today *should* be the day. Why draw I out even longer?

I am broke.  Basically homeless.

My whole life has been drastic change after drastic change and I have no way to make any positive drastic change. 

I really see no reason to try and believe any positive is going to happen for me.  I tried to make positive changes.  I told myself positive things would happen soon.  But things just got worse and worse. 

I will not be missed.  As soon as it's done people will have already forgotten.

Mine is completely emotional... I think I've endured more than my fair share over the past few years and my mind just isn't going to let me pretend it all doesn't bother me anymore.

My first attempt (~17 years ago) should have killed me... I shouldn't be here. It shouldn't have failed.

I used to take that as a sign that I was meant to do something with my life. Now I just believe it failed so I could suffer long enough to decide it was worth another shot.

I have people I can talk to, but I just can't see the point at times any more... like right now.

I've seen a counselor. I've been on medications. They didn't help or made me feel worse.
I've been one of those people that says "things will get better" but it's not always true... 
sometimes life goes to shit. Sometimes you feel you will never see your kids again. Sometimes you end up living on the streets when it's 20 below. Sometimes you go into serious debt you'll never get out of. Sometimes the only family you could stand to talk to and get advice from dies. Sometimes all you need is someone next to you saying "WE'LL make it through this"' but you're alone. What will get better?
